blurb: Guests drive their own two-seat catamarans while a guide leads on a separate boat around Hilton Head Island waterways. The tours include learning about local history and ecosystems. They also offer a 20-passenger party cycleboat for group outings.
groupInfo: Cycleboat holds 20 passengers, suitable for parties and company outings

quotes.text: We went on Blue Water Adventures for my husbands birthday. We had a blast! Bailey was our guide and he was fun and engaging! Taught us some history about the surrounding islands and lores. We are locals and will definitely go again in the near future. Totally worth it.

I took my 10-year-old son out with Captain Nick for the first time ever last week. We both loved it. Captain Nick was awesome. He has incredible knowledge of the local history and the waters. It was an absolute blast and we will definitely do it again

Had an incredible time on this excursion! Bailey was our guide and he was great! You should definitely request for him and go on this wonderful adventure! We saw a few dolphins on it as well so if you wanna see dolphins and have fun go on this!

We had an amazing time that we will always remember! We loved the beauty of being out on the water and the thrilling adventure of driving the boat. Nick, our guide, was so knowledgeable and made it a great trip!

I would highly recommend this! It was the best part of the vacation. They were very friendly, explained everything very well and we had a great day on the water. So much fun, I can't wait to do it again!
Great time with Captain Tom today!! He is a super cool and very knowledgeable. Loved the local info that he provided throughout the tour. Boats are funny and easy to drive. Definitely do it again.
